simple.meaning: מִזְעָר (mizʻâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “fewness ; by implication, as superlative diminutiveness.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִזְעָר (H4213) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 10:25, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִזְעָר (H4213) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִזְעָר (H4213) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִזְעָר (mizʻâr) / H4213 is traced through Isaiah 10:25, Isaiah 16:14, Isaiah 24:6, Isaiah 29:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: fewness ; by implication, as superlative diminutiveness

firstOccurrence.englishText: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

timeline.evidenceText: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

definitions.short: fewness ; by implication, as superlative diminutiveness
definitions.full: H4213. mizar מִזְעָר noun [masculine] a little, a trifle, a few . 1 of time מִזְעָ֑ר מְעַט עוֺד Isa 10:25 ; 29:17 yet a trifle, a little = a very little while. 2 of number שְׁאָר מִזְעָר מְעַט Isa 16:14 a remnant, a very few (opposed to בִּיר כַּ לוֺא ). In Isa 3 without מעט : — אנושׁ ׃ונשׁאר מִזְעָֽר 24:6 .
